verdict.rationale: USCIS documents paper filing by mail as an alternative to online filing, and names the forms used to pay fees when filing by mail (G-1450 for card payments, G-1650 for ACH from a U.S. bank account). The pack does not show where or how to send those filings. Missing for 10: published mailing/lockbox addresses, fax or phone numbers for the fallback rail, explicit guidance on using paper when the online flow is unavailable, and any hands-on corroboration.
